Time is the tax: 13 minutes for one agent, 5902 minutes for 454 fakes, charged every epoch without fail. A farm can print a river, it can fake a garden, but it cannot backdate a spiral without the archive noticing. Check the record, count the cost, and the farm's story falls apart.
